why: No major reviewer or authority answers the all-NVMe NAS question. TechSpot and PC Gamer cover HDD NAS units or SSD deals. Only ComputingForGeeks addresses all-flash NAS, using throughput figures borrowed from other reviewers rather than its own tests. The rest are guides to HDD 4-bay units, SSD-for-cache pages, and affiliate lists.
